_doc: A complete design showing every feature mix.py understands, for a 12 s launch-video beat (cursor click, typing, whoosh into a transition, cards popping in, riser -> hero reveal hit, logo sting). It works as a single-file design (mix.py --design this.json) or as one category fragment listed in sounddesign.json 'include' (then 'duration', 'buses' and 'master' are read only from the top-level file). Keys starting with _ are comments. Every 'file' is a real licensed recording listed in a manifest (audio/assets/manifests/*.json). Prefix every name with the fragment's category so fragments never collide. Reference: references/design-format.md.

ui.press._doc: the press half of a real mouse click: trim 3-5 ms before the attack, end before the release

mo.whoosh._doc: a real swish (stick / cloth / bamboo past the mic); placed by its peak on the move's velocity peak

fx.riser._doc: a real cymbal roll / orchestral swell; aligned by its END so it stops on the reveal

logo.chime._doc: the sting: one soft real bell / celesta note, in the music's key (resample with pitch to tune, within +-2 st)

kb.type._doc: one recording of a mechanical keyboard typing, cut at its onsets into single keys: kb.type#0, kb.type#1 ... (check them with --dump)

rules.name: ui.click press
rules._doc: one voice at one level for every click in the film

rules.name: fx.riser
rules._doc: ends 30 ms before the reveal: a beat of air before the hit

rules.name: logo.chime
rules._doc: on the frame the wordmark becomes readable (its settle), never later

place._doc: a free placement (no cue event): a soft air lift that peaks just before the chime

ambience.name: am.room
ambience._doc: a quiet real room tone under the UI part; src_start..src_end is a clean window (no events), looped with a 1.5 s crossfade if needed

music._doc: one licensed track, edited at bar lines (arrange.py drafts the segments). src_* are ORIGINAL source seconds; 'at' is film time. 'at' can be nudged a few ms so the measured downbeat transient lands on the picture's downbeat.

segments.label: intro bars 1-4 (soft, no drums) under the UI
drop bars 17-18 on the hero reveal, ring out under the logo

_buses_doc: buses and master are read from the top-level design only. auto = [[film t, dB], ...] piecewise-linear fader rides: here the music dips 6 dB under the typing and comes back for the whoosh

master._doc: read from the top-level design only. -14 LUFS for web/social; ceiling 0.77 linear (-2.3 dBFS): measure about -1 dBTP after AAC
